children: Vince reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 net sales of $81.8 million, an 11.7% increase vs. the prior-year quarter, and raised its full-year guidance for the Vince business. GAAP net income for the quarter was $10.6 million, or $0.80 diluted, while adjusted diluted EPS was $1.02 reflecting non-GAAP adjustments. The company completed the acquisition of October’s Very Own (OVO) operating business during the quarter and highlighted tariff refund benefits and transaction-related costs in the results.
Revenue: Total net sales of $81.8 million for the three months ended August 1, 2026, up 11.7% from $73.2 million in 2Q25.
Gross profit and margin: Gross profit of $49.8 million, representing 60.9% of net sales (includes $10.4 million IEEPA tariff refund benefit).
Operating income: Income from operations of $13.6 million for the quarter.
Net income and EPS: GAAP net income of $10.6 million, or $0.80 per diluted share; adjusted net income of $13.5 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $1.02.
Adjusted EBITDA: Adjusted EBITDA of $18.0 million for the quarter (non-GAAP).
Channel performance: Direct-to-consumer sales increased 13.7% to $32.4 million; wholesale sales increased 10.4% to $49.4 million.
Tariff refund impact: The quarter benefited from IEEPA tariff refunds (totaling $10.4 million across segments), which materially improved reported gross margin.
OVO acquisition: Completed acquisition of the OVO operating business; purchased a 5% equity interest in OVO IP for $6 million and aims to expand OVO’s retail and wholesale presence.
Retail footprint: Company ended the quarter operating 53 company-operated Vince stores (41 full-price and 12 outlet stores noted in corporate overview).
Liquidity and balance sheet: Total borrowings of $12.3 million under debt agreements with $63.6 million of excess availability on the revolving credit facility at quarter end.

title: Vince reports Q2 revenue up 11.7% to $81.8M; raises full-year guidance
